    if not s or s in ('nan', 'none'):
        return np.nan
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    if 'tr' in s:
        (left, right) = s.split('tr', 1)
        try:
            base = float(left.replace(',', '.')) if left else 0.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
        extra = 0.0
        if right:
            try:
                extra = float(right) * 1000.0
            except Exception:
                extra = 0.0
        return base * 1000000.0 + extra
    if s.endswith('k'):
        try:
            return float(s[:-1].replace(',', '.')) * 1000.0
        except Exception:
            return np.nan
    s = re.sub('[^0-9.\\-]', '', s.replace(',', ''))

    try:

    if mask.any():
        out.loc[mask] = pd.Timestamp('1899-12-30') + pd.to_timedelta(num.loc[mask], unit='D')
    rest = s.notna() & ~mask
    if rest.any():

        t = t.str.replace('\\s*thg\\s*', '/', regex=True)
        parts = t.str.extract('^(\\d{1,4})[-/](\\d{1,2})[-/](\\d{1,4})')
